thingvellir.reason: Real photo of Thingvellir's characteristic rift cliffs with the Icelandic flag flying; correctly identifies the landscape landmark.

timbuktu-mali.reason: Real photo, and it is in Timbuktu, but it's a tight shot of the Sankore Mosque facade with a couple of people on a sand street — an isolated monument crop, not a view of the city.

topkapi-palace.reason: Real photo clearly showing a Topkapi Palace courtyard/pool with its distinctive arcades and dome; this is a landmark entry, not a city, so a close architectural view is appropriate.

tower-bridge-london.reason: Real photo of Tower Bridge from the Thames, unmistakable and correctly depicts the landmark.

tucson-usa.reason: Shows the entrance plaza/signage of the Tucson Museum of Art (red and blue wall art installation) with only a sliver of downtown skyline behind — an isolated building/art piece, not a city view of Tucson.

tunis-tunisia.reason: Real aerial panorama clearly showing the city of Tunis sprawling to the horizon — a genuine city view, not an isolated monument.

tristan-da-cunha.reason: Authentic satellite (ASTER) photo of the island showing its distinctive round shape and central volcano — a real photo that accurately depicts the place; appropriate since there's no city here.

two-lovers-point.reason: Real photo of the viewing platform/gazebo at Two Lovers Point with visitors and ocean view, correctly shows the landmark.

uluru.reason: Real photo of Uluru glowing red at sunset, unmistakably the landmark.

uppsala-cathedral-d34-35.reason: Real photo of Uppsala Cathedral's twin spires with the town visible behind it; correctly depicts the landmark.

valle-de-la-luna-chile.reason: Real photo of the sand dunes and eroded rock formations characteristic of Valle de la Luna, Atacama.

valletta.reason: Real photo showing Valletta's skyline from the harbor with its domes, bastion walls, and waterfront — a genuine city view.

vienna-austria.reason: Real photo of Vienna's skyline (mixed historic rooftops and modern towers) — a genuine city view, not a single monument.

vestmannaeyjar-iceland.reason: Shows a small metal sculpture on a rocky shoreline with cliffs — generic coastal scene with no identifiable feature of the town of Vestmannaeyjar; doesn't clearly depict this specific place.

waitomo-caves.reason: Shows the exterior of the Waitomo Hotel at night — does not show the caves at all, which is the entire point of this entry.

waikiki.reason: Real photo of Waikiki Beach with Diamond Head crater in the background, correctly identifies the place.

westminster-abbey-gb.reason: Real photo of Westminster Abbey's west front, clearly and correctly depicted.

western-wall-jerusalem.reason: Shows a signed entrance tunnel/archway ("The Western Wall Heritage") rather than the actual Western Wall itself — does not show the place.

whitehorse-yukon.reason: Real photo showing a wide view of Whitehorse town with surrounding mountains — a genuine city/town view.

wounded-knee-creek.reason: Real (older, low-quality) photo of the Wounded Knee memorial marker on the hill at the historic site; image quality is poor but it does depict the actual site.

yerevan.reason: Real photo of the Yerevan skyline with Mount Ararat behind it — a genuine city view.

yellowknife-nwt.reason: Real photo showing downtown Yellowknife's skyline and surrounding terrain — a genuine city view.

york-minster-d34-3.reason: Real photo of York Minster rising above the city's rooftops, correctly depicts the landmark.

yosemite-valley.reason: Shows the LeConte Memorial Lodge, a single small stone building among trees — does not show Yosemite Valley's landscape, which is what this entry is meant to depict.

zermatt-ch.reason: Real photo of Zermatt village lit up at dusk with the Matterhorn towering above — correctly shows both the town and its defining landmark.

zugspitze-summit.reason: Shows a "Welcome to Tirol" sign at a cable-car station interior, not the Zugspitze summit itself; mountains are only faintly visible through windows in the background.
